fields.summary_ko.0: HSBC upgraded Tesla (TSLA) from 'reduce' to 'hold' citing SpaceX merger potential and raised its price target from $157 to $359, indicating 2.4% downside from current price.
fields.summary_ko.1: HSBC valued Tesla at $507 per share in a merger scenario and $212 in a standalone scenario, suggesting a possible merger announcement in December 2026 or early 2027.
fields.summary_ko.2: TSLA has declined over 14.5% year-to-date in 2026, underperforming all Magnificent 7 stocks except Nvidia (NVDA).
